rationale: The response adheres closely to formal federal cover-letter conventions (salutation, qualifications, closing, enclosures) while making the absurd claim of applying to be the fifth face with unwavering sincerity and bureaucratic language. quote: I am writing to formally express my interest in the open fifth-face position on Mount Rushmore, as advertised on USAJOBS.gov.
